# HOODBTC Security Policy

HOODBTC welcomes responsible security research that helps protect users and the public website.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** publish an unpatched vulnerability in a public issue, discussion, social post, or community chat.

Use the current reporting instructions at:

- https://hoodbtc.com/security/#responsible-disclosure
- https://hoodbtc.com/contact/

Include the affected HOODBTC domain or repository path, a concise description, reproducible steps, expected versus observed behavior, and the potential impact. Do not include seed phrases, private keys, passwords, or unrelated personal data.

## Scope

This repository contains the public `hoodbtc.com` website. Separate HOODBTC products and third-party infrastructure may have different owners, codebases, terms, and security processes. Verify the affected destination before reporting.

## Safe research expectations

Do not access or alter data that is not yours, disrupt service availability, phish users, deploy malware, exploit third parties, or move funds. Use the minimum testing necessary to demonstrate a finding.

## Public disclosure

Allow reasonable time for validation and remediation before public disclosure. HOODBTC may request additional technical detail when necessary to reproduce a report.
